title: Focus
wikitext:
{{Skill infobox|id=Focus}}
{{redirect|Focused|the item|Focused Amulet}}

'''Focus''' is a [[skill]] that grants the Focused [[buff]]. The buff does not do anything by itself, but certain [[veiled modifier]]s will grant bonuses while Focused. The Focus skill will automatically be granted to any character with an [[item]] with a [[modifier]] related to being Focused. 

==Mechanics==
The Focus skill cannot have [[support gem]]s applied to it. Socketing a support gem to an item with a Focus modifier will do nothing.

Focused is unaffected by modifiers to buff effect or duration.

Focus starts on cooldown upon entering a new instance.

==Unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id = "grant_focus_skill" OR items.name LIKE "%Paradoxica%" OR items.name = "The Queen's Hunger"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Related modifiers==

}}
